args.body:
Dear New Asiaway Private Dining Team,

I am writing to request a table for 12 people next Friday (May 17, 2024). My name is Emma Johnson, and I would like to inquire about availability and any special arrangements for a group of this size.

Please let me know if you have availability and any requirements or preferences we should be aware of.

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
